name: detect-results
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'ai/**'
    paths:
      - 'results/**'
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: POST changed results files to MUSE receiver
        env:
          WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ vars.MUSE_RESULTS_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
            echo "MUSE_RESULTS_WEBHOOK_URL is not set. Skipping."
            exit 0
          fi
          FILES=$(jq -c '[.commits[] | (.added + .modified)[] | select(startswith("results/"))] | unique' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          jq -n --arg sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --argjson files "$FILES" '{sha: $sha, files: $files}' > /tmp/payload.json
          curl -sS -X POST "$WEBHOOK_URL" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data @/tmp/payload.json
